<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="tinderGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cardGradient" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FF7854"/>
      <stop offset="55%" stop-color="#FE3675"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#C42936"/>
    </linearGradient>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="7" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.16"/>
    </filter>
    <filter id="softShadow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="170%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity="0.10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F5F7FA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="29" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="20" y="19" font-family="SF Pro, Arial" font-size="13" font-weight="600" fill="#000000">9:41</text>
  <line x1="329" y1="15" x2="332" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="12" x2="338" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="9" x2="344" y2="15" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="357" cy="14" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="357" y1="14" x2="360" y2="11" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="368" y="9" width="19" height="11" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <rect x="370" y="11" width="14" height="7" rx="1.5" fill="#000000"/>
  <rect x="388" y="12" width="2" height="5" rx="1" fill="#000000"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="29" width="390" height="65" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <text x="195" y="70" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="25" font-weight="700" fill="url(#tinderGradient)">tinder</text>
  <circle cx="30" cy="61" r="18" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="57" r="5" fill="#939393"/>
  <ellipse cx="30" cy="68" rx="9" ry="5" fill="#939393"/>
  <circle cx="360" cy="61" r="18" fill="#F2F2F6"/>
  <circle cx="360" cy="57" r="3" fill="#939393"/>
  <rect x="354" y="61" width="12" height="8" rx="4" fill="#939393"/>
  <circle cx="368" cy="52" r="4" fill="#FE3675" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Empty-state content -->
  <text x="195" y="131" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="20" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">No messages yet</text>
  <text x="195" y="154" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="13" fill="#939393">Your matches will appear here</text>

  <!-- layered swipe cards -->
  <g filter="url(#softShadow)">
    <rect x="96" y="185" width="198" height="277" rx="16" fill="#D9D9D9" transform="rotate(8 195 323)"/>
    <rect x="78" y="180" width="198" height="277" rx="16" fill="#EAEDF1" transform="rotate(-7 177 318)"/>
  </g>

  <!-- central illustrated swipe card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="88" y="174" width="214" height="292" rx="17" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="88" y="174" width="214" height="214" rx="17" fill="url(#cardGradient)"/>
    <rect x="88" y="370" width="214" height="18" fill="url(#cardGradient)"/>

    <!-- landscape illustration -->
    <circle cx="253" cy="224" r="27" fill="#EFC54D" opacity="0.95"/>
    <polygon points="88,352 143,281 177,320 205,290 264,352" fill="#EA5D6B"/>
    <polygon points="155,352 205,290 302,352" fill="#C42936" opacity="0.88"/>
    <polygon points="88,352 133,314 156,337 181,313 218,352" fill="#96E063" opacity="0.95"/>
    <line x1="88" y1="352" x2="302" y2="352" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" opacity="0.5"/>

    <!-- profile illustration -->
    <circle cx="195" cy="250" r="27" fill="#FFFFFF" opacity="0.9"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="239" r="10" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <ellipse cx="195" cy="262" rx="18" ry="11" fill="#4A4A4A"/>
    <circle cx="187" cy="240" r="3" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="203" cy="240" r="3" fill="#FE3675"/>

    <rect x="108" y="401" width="82" height="27" rx="6" fill="#F5F7FA"/>
    <text x="149" y="420" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="15" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">LIKE</text>
    <text x="108" y="449" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="12" fill="#939393">Swipe right to connect</text>
  </g>

  <!-- swipe indicators -->
  <g opacity="0.9">
    <circle cx="131" cy="503" r="27" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <line x1="119" y1="503" x2="143" y2="503" stroke="#C42936" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="503" r="31" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="503" r="16" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="3"/>
    <polyline points="195,492 195,514 184,503 195,492 206,503" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="259" cy="503" r="27" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>
    <polygon points="259,488 263,499 275,499 266,506 269,518 259,511 249,518 252,506 243,499 255,499" fill="#EFC54D"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="568" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="22" font-weight="700" fill="#4A4A4A">Get swiping</text>
  <text x="195" y="593" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" fill="#939393">Start discovering people near you</text>
  <g>
    <rect x="104" y="616" width="182" height="44" rx="62" fill="url(#tinderGradient)"/>
    <text x="195" y="644" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">START SWIPING</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Navigation bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="746" width="390" height="98" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="746" x2="390" y2="746" stroke="#EAEDF1" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- discovery -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="48,765 60,759 66,771 54,777" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="768" r="2" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <text x="57" y="800" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">Discover</text>
  </g>

  <!-- likes -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="147" cy="768" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="143" cy="765" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
    <circle cx="151" cy="765" r="2" fill="#939393"/>
    <polyline points="142,771 147,775 152,771" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="147" y="800" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Likes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- matches -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="243" cy="768" r="10" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="239" cy="765" r="2" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <circle cx="247" cy="765" r="2" fill="#FE3675"/>
    <polyline points="238,771 243,775 248,771" fill="none" stroke="#FE3675" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="253" cy="758" r="4" fill="#FE3675" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="243" y="800" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" font-weight="700" fill="#FE3675">Matches</text>
  </g>

  <!-- profile -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="333" cy="764" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="333" cy="776" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#939393" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="333" y="800" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Gotham, Arial" font-size="10" fill="#939393">Profile</text>
  </g>

  <rect x="154" y="829" width="82" height="5" rx="3" fill="#000000"/>
</svg>
